Players Committee card image of [[Anakin Skywalker (V) (Errata)]] (PC-E1 image; errata mark “E”), printing: “USED: Unless Twilight Is Upon Me on table, ▲ [Cloud City] or [Endor] Leia or [Dagobah] Luke. LOST: During a battle at a site involving [Endor] Leia or [Dagobah] or [Death Star II] Luke, choose: Add one destiny to attrition. OR Cancel the game text of a character of ability < 4.” Uploaded unchanged.

Source: the Players Committee Holotable image set, file [https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/2f0f28b/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/hires/anakinskywalker.png Images-HT/starwars/Virtual13-Light/hires/anakinskywalker.png] as of commit 2f0f28b “2021 March Errata” (18 March 2021).
